name: Boston Dynamics Spot
summary: A 34 kg four-legged robot that walks routes on its own and carries up to 14 kg of cameras, thermal sensors or laser scanners for site documentation and plant inspection rounds.

germany.statusNote: Sold in Germany on request: Boston Dynamics runs its European sales and service office near Frankfurt, and ELP GmbH (Wuppertal) is a listed EMEA reseller offering Spot packages. No public euro price. Génération Robots has one used Spot Explorer package for 20,016 € net.

sellers.name: Boston Dynamics (European office near Frankfurt)
sellers.note: European office co-located at Hyundai WIA near Frankfurt handles local sales, service and field application engineering.

sellers.name: ELP GmbH European Logistic Partners
sellers.note: Listed as Boston Dynamics reseller partner for EMEA. Offers Basic Spot and the Spot EAM inspection package (dock, CAM 2). Sells only to business and public-authority customers; focus is public safety.

sellers.name: Génération Robots
sellers.note: USED Spot (Explorer package with 2 batteries, charger, tablet), one unit, delivery 24 to 48 h; 24,019.20 € incl. VAT. Year, condition and warranty not stated. New Spot is quote only.

specs.label: Payload on body
specs.conditions: maximum on M5 T-slot rails, mounting area 850 x 240 x 270 mm

specs.label: Stairs
specs.conditions: climbs metal staircases in plant use

specs.label: Average runtime
specs.conditions: 90 min average, varies with payload and environment; standby 180 min

specs.label: Built-in terrain sensing
specs.value: 360° perception, 4 m range, needs more than 2 lux

specs.label: Inspection payloads
specs.value: Spot CAM 2 (camera), Spot EAP 2 (lidar), Sorama L642 acoustic camera, MFE gas detection, Spot Core I/O, Spot Arm; kits for inspection (EAM), public safety and research

specs.label: SDK
specs.value: Spot SDK and API, Orbit fleet software

specs.label: Self-charging
specs.conditions: dock needs shelter, operating -20 to 35 °C, charge 2 to 3.5 h

notes: The base robot has no inspection camera; Spot CAM 2, the EAP 2 lidar, acoustic or gas payloads are sold separately and share the 14 kg limit.
Autonomous charging needs the separate Spot Dock, which must be sheltered.
Not for private buyers: Boston Dynamics sells only for commercial, industrial and research use.
